blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano clarified on Tuesday that his colleagues in the upper chamber remain free to make their own decisions should they be offered the role of vice president. This comes after Sen. Panfilo Lacson criticized Cayetano’s call for their colleagues to reject any nomination to replace Vice President Sara Duterte if she were convicted. “Everyone remains free to decide. I hope we can consider the concern behind the invitation before taking offense at being asked,” Cayetano wrote in a social media post.
